title.zh: 将八打雁省八打雁市Malalim描笼涯小学正式更名为Eulalia Talban Ebora纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Malalim Elementary School in Barangay Malalim, City of Batangas, Province of Batangas to Eulalia Talban Ebora Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Malalim Elementary School in Barangay Malalim, City of Batangas, Province of Batangas to Eulalia Talban Ebora Memorial Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2013/ra_10508_2013.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of an Elementary School. – The name of Malalim Elementary School in Barangay Malalim, City of Batangas, Province of Batangas is hereby changed to Eulalia Talban Ebora Memorial Elementary School.

Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of the Eulalia Talban Ebora Memorial Elementary School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Malalim, City of Batangas, Province of Batangas.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
